basic_details.job_title: Panjab University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in Social Work or Ph.D. awarded as per UGC regulations.
qualification.details: Master's Degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Social Work from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the Master's level for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC)/Scheduled Tribes (ST)/Backward Classes (BC)/Persons with Disabilities (PwD), as per UGC/Panjab University norms. Cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC/CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC, such as SLET/SET, or must have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, and amendments thereto. Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to 11 July 2009 shall be governed by the then existing UGC Regulations/University Ordinances and shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of the conditions prescribed by the UGC, duly certified by the Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs). Experience of teaching Postgraduate classes of Master of Social Work.

salary_details.details: ₹1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹50,000/- per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Panjab University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty position at Panjab University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application form for the Guest Faculty position at Panjab University is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Social Work with 55% marks and have cleared NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D. degree as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q3. How is the selection made for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty position at Panjab University will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty position is ₹1,500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly earning of ₹50,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this Guest Faculty recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Faculty post at Panjab University.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Panjab University at https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I submit along with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to submit two sets of self-attested copies of all testimonials/certificates and two recent passport-size photographs with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the Guest Faculty position is scheduled to be held on 25th August 2026.
